components.text: The Rune of The Orb increases the capacity of the Blood Orb that is inside of the Altar by +2% additively per rune while it is inside of the Altar.

With Netherite Scrap and Hellforged Parts, you can upgrade a Rune of the Orb to its augmented form, increasing the orb's capacity by an additive +4% per rune. If you change your mind, you can undo the upgrade in the Alchemical Reaction Chamber (ARC).
